title_card.title: Terracotta soldiers were colorful.
title_card.subtitle: Vibrant paint once covered the clay armour.

caption:
The Terracotta Army in China was originally painted in bright colours rather than plain grey.

Excavators who uncovered the subterranean pits near Xi'an in 1974 discovered traces of red, blue, and green pigments on the clay warriors. The synthetic pigments quickly flaked off upon exposure to dry air.

Visuals created with AI.

Did you know these ancient statues were once painted?
